subject: That is one long sentence...
author: Xandu
body:
It's like reading one of your monster blogs out loud 😛

That was a cool review. Pretty much sums up the game. 🙂 It can be very frustrating at times... driving on a cushion of air or the bollocks takedowns online or crashing at the finish line when you are 2 miles ahead and respawn just in time to snatch 5th. But it will all be fixed in version 1.2! At least I hope so.

-- The Creator --
